notes: Malik. Numbers are a first pass copied from Avner's matching moves; the art is the newer drawings (Nov 25), which came without holds: which drawing each hit lands on is a first reading of them (5L: 3; 5M: 2 and 3 of its sheet; 5H: 5; 2L: 4 of the sheet; 2M: 4; 2H: 5; 5S: 4; Back Heavy: 4; 6M stomp: 3; j.L: 3; j.M: 3; j.H: 3, with the spirit hand's drawing 4 on the same frame; j.S: 4; Spirit Orb: the palm on drawing 4, or 5 for H, and the orb leaves on the next; Vow strikes: 4). The stomp (6M) and Guardian Ward (4R) are new moves with first-guess numbers. Every stat is the system default. All art is cut to one body size (186 px tall standing).
